title: Chern normalization under the actual comparison mate
statement: For n>0, finite A killed by n and effective Cartier i:D→Z with n invertible on Z, the canonical comparison class [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class] satisfies GeoCartierChernEquation [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface], using the Kummer Chern class of the dual Cartier ideal and the specified pro-etale constant-to-support map.

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary boundary representative, derived arrow and Kummer Chern class from the ordinary supported Kummer theorem. Boundary uniqueness identifies its representative with the canonical ordinary class.

proof.text: The exact direct-image single-object comparison intertwines the ordinary derived unit and supportedExactDerivedMap with precomposition by the constant-to-support unit in Ext. Apply it to the ordinary unit equation. The integral-generator equation for the supplied Chern witness is unchanged.

proof.text: The comparison mate commutes with units by the adjunction triangle identities. Apply exact comparison inverse image to the ordinary Ext equation, identify constants by their canonical comparison, and cancel the invertible supported mate. This is the specified pro-etale Chern equation, with the positive boundary of the dual ideal. Empty support and zero coefficients give zero.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierCanonicalClass_chern (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) {D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) :
    GeoCartierChernEquation A n hA i hI hZ
      (geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i hI hZ)
